messages:
lia (AE): Hey team — prospect flagged a subtle 'protocol drift' when switching from CompetitorX to Redwood. They see header/body differences and slightly different token counts that break their billing reconciliation. Need a short smoke-sprint plan and answers for SSO/KMS + pricing for a 3-month POC.

marta (SE): Got it. Can you drop an example request/response pair? even just the minimal prompt that repros the billing delta.

lia (AE): pasted below (redacted):
`POST /v1/generate`
`{"prompt":"Summarize ux research notes...","max_tokens":256}`
CompetitorX returns 1,234 tokens billed; Redwood returns 1,188 tokens.

devin (SW): Most likely tokenization/model variant difference or default stop/echo behavior. Do we know which model they compared (CompetitorX-gpt-medium vs our rdx-medium-v1)?

lia (AE): They said 'gx-medium' -> asked us to replace with rdx-medium-v1.

marta (SE): Action plan: 1) run a side-by-side tokenization probe (same prompt, max_tokens 0) across both endpoints; 2) run a small smoke suite with 10 varied prompts covering multi-turn context and stop tokens; 3) record token counts + deltas; 4) propose normalization shim if needed. I can own the smoke run.

omar (SRE): Will need the prospect's test IP range so we can whitelist egress for Dedicated/PVC testing. Also note that if they use SSO with their IdP we need SAML metadata early.

lia (AE): Prospect provided test infra: 52.23.112.0/24 and they want SAML + KMS.

secbot: Security checklist link: https://redwood.internal/sec/qna/prospects. For KMS: we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and HSM integrations; need an ARN and a contact to run key provisioning. For SAML: we expect metadata XML and an SP-initiated flow config.

devin (SW): For the normalization shim: we can strip model-specific tokenization differences by re-tokenizing with our tokenizer and attaching a normalized token_count field in the response. That avoids changing downstream billing logic temporarily. Example patch: 
```json
{"normalized_token_count": 1188, "raw_token_count": 1220}
```
It’s cheap to add as a sidecar for the POC.

kevin (Sales Eng): Pricing note: for a 3-month POC with Dedicated-like throughput (we'll simulate on hosted but reserve burst capacity), we can offer a usage credit estimate. Need expected RPS and total token volume. Lia, ask them to fill the quick sizing sheet: https://redwood.sales/sizing-template (one page).

lia (AE): I asked for RPS and avg prompt size. They expect ~50 RPS peak, 1.5k tokens avg per call (incl. context), approx 130M tokens total over 90 days.

kevin (Sales Eng): With that footprint we can propose: 1) Hosted + Burst (no commit) with a $30k credit applied, or 2) Dev Dedicated trial: $12k/mo reserved with up to 2x burst. I'll draft both options.

marta (SE): Also adding test vectors: short prompt, long prompt, convo with system messages, JSON-schema output, and a tokenization sensitivity case where stop sequences differ. I'll post results in this thread once smoke run is done.

devin (SW): One implementation caveat: CompetitorX echoes system-level metadata in the response body header sometimes. We shouldn't rely on that. If their downstream glue expects it, we'll need to inject a compat header `x-cx-meta` in the proxy. Quick shim is trivial.

contracts (Legal): If prospect needs vendor attestations, we can provide SOC2 + DPA. They mentioned additional compliance questionnaires — share them and we'll triage.

lia (AE): They're sending over a shorter security questionnaire and an SSO test user. I'll attach both.

omar (SRE): For network: Dedicated test cluster IPs will be provided tomorrow. Also note that rate limit headers differ: CompetitorX uses `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, we expose `X-RW-Quota-Remaining`. We can map names in the proxy if they depend on header names.

marta (SE): ETA: smoke run + normalization proposal by EOD tomorrow. If differences are >5% token delta on avg, propose the normalized_token_count shim + a short billing reconciliation doc for the customer.

lia (AE): Awesome — I'll tell them to expect the POC plan and the two pricing options. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

kevin (Sales Eng): I'll prepare the cost estimate and sample commitment math. cc @marta for consumption numbers.

devin (SW): One more: if they rely on exact text-match from the competitor, we should include a response-delta eval (n-gram, BLEU-like) so PMs can decide acceptance thresholds. I can wire a small script to compute similarity scores and attach to the smoke run.

lia (AE): Perfect. Closing loop: I'll update the prospect with: whitelist IPs, provide SAML metadata + test user, expect POC plan tomorrow, pricing options next business day.

marta (SE): Copy.

secbot: Note: if KMS keys are customer-managed, provisioning adds ~3 business days for audit and rotation setup.

lia (AE): Noted. Thank you all.
